title: Open Harness Protocol - Declared Evaluation Cases Schema
description: Schema for a standalone case declaration consumed by a deterministic runner (RFC-0012). The same case objects may appear under the profile seam's 'cases' array.

id.description: Unique identifier within the case set.

description.description: What this case is intended to observe.

command.description: Deterministic command executed in the declared working directory.

expect.description: Observable predicates. A case passes when every declared predicate holds.

stdout_contains.description: Substring that must appear in combined stdout and stderr.

artifact.description: Path, relative to the working directory, that must exist afterwards.

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock limit. Exceeding it is reported as timeout, not failure.

budget_tokens.description: Declared invocation ceiling, never a measurement.
